difference.question: How is SlimPDF different from iLovePDF or Smallpdf?
difference.answer: SlimPDF uses server-side Ghostscript, the same compression engine used by professional print shops. Browser-based tools use JavaScript which typically achieves 20-40% reduction. We achieve up to 90%.

security.question: Are my files secure?
security.answer: Yes. All transfers use 256-bit encryption. Files are automatically deleted after 1 hour (free) or 24 hours (Pro). We never store or analyze your content.

targetSize.question: Can I compress to a specific file size?
targetSize.answer: Yes! Pro users can set a target like 'under 10MB' for email. We iterate compression until we hit your target while maintaining readable quality.

watermarks.question: Do you add watermarks?
watermarks.answer: Never. Your files come out clean on all plans.

api.question: How does the API work?
api.answer: Pro subscribers get REST API access for all tools. Simple endpoints, code examples in Python, JavaScript, and curl. 100 requests per hour included.

signup.question: Do I need to sign up?
signup.answer: No signup required for free tier. Compress, merge, or convert up to 2 files per day without an account.

platforms.question: What platforms are supported?
platforms.answer: SlimPDF works in any modern browser on Mac, Windows, Linux, iPad, and mobile. No software to install.

batch.question: Can I process multiple files at once?
batch.answer: Pro users can batch process up to 20 files at once across all tools. Results download as a ZIP file.
